title: EU mining plans in the Western Balkans face local resistance
lede: While EU leaders hunt for “green” metals in the Western Balkans, villagers from Jadar to Vareš warn the only thing guaranteed so far is polluted land, opaque permits and profits vanishing far from their communities.
